headline: Dangote Group Explores Industrial Expansion Into Egypt
summary: Dangote Group is exploring investment opportunities in Egypt, aiming to extend its manufacturing and industrial operations outside its home market of Nigeria.
why: Dangote Group, controlled by Aliko Dangote, is one of Africa's largest diversified conglomerates with interests spanning cement, refining, and petrochemicals.

impacts.name: Dangote Group
impacts.why: Entering Egypt opens new North African market share but requires cross-border capital expenditure.
